result.reason: The added paragraph fully reaches the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback durations. It expressly carves the warranties out of the broad disclaimer and adds only the requested performance, conformity, duration, legal-compliance, malicious-code, and remedy terms. Drafting is generally effective, although the professional/workmanlike wording is repetitive and the remedy formulation is somewhat awkward for legal-compliance or malicious-code breaches because it is framed around “non-conforming” Services, deliverables, or Licensed Software.
